    AI Overview
    Scottie Scheffler has won the Masters Tournament twice, securing his green jackets in 2022 and 2024. He won his first title by three strokes and his second by a four-stroke margin, solidifying his dominance at Augusta National. 
    Key Details of Wins: 
    • 2022 Masters: Finished at 10-under par, earning his first major championship and PGA Tour win.
    • 2024 Masters: Finished at 11-under par, winning his second green jacket. 
    As of the conclusion of the 2026 Masters, Scheffler remains a two-time champion, having finished runner-up in 2026

    People also ask
    What year did Scottie Scheffler win the Masters?
    He had a breakout season in 2022: in the span of three months, he recorded his first victory on the PGA Tour, rose to world number one and won his first major championship at the 2022 Masters Tournament. Scheffler won The Players Championship in 2023 and 2024, becoming the first to win the title in back-to-back years.

    Who has won all 4 Masters?
    Only six golfers have won all four of golf's modern majors at any time during their careers, an achievement which is often referred to as a Career Grand Slam: Gene Sarazen, Ben Hogan, Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, Tiger Woods, and Rory McIlroy.
